results.title: Manami Guid Mag **** sa Mansion
results.overview: During the American colonial period in Brgy. Paraiso, Sagay City, Negros Occidental, the American-owned Insular Lumber Company established one of the largest hardwood logging operations in the world under a government forest concession. The film follows Caloy, a young laborer sent to deliver the payroll to a hacendero’s mansion on the night a catastrophe descends upon Sagay. As it tears through the workers’ settlement, the hacendero couple remains sheltered inside their mansion.

results.title: American Voices 2026
results.overview: Over the past six years, a team of filmmakers has been following more than a dozen Americans in eight states across the U.S., charting their views about changes in the country and in their own lives. Now, a month before the midterm elections, how are these Americans — from a doctor to a pastor to a barber to a construction company owner to a retiree — feeling about the direction of the country? "American Voices 2026" asks how their hopes and fears have evolved amid another polarizing election season, a faltering economy, and a war with Iran that's now in its eighth month.

results.title: Kalpana Aur Yatharth
results.overview: The story of the film originated from real and fictional events revolves around the unreal world, through which a man embarks on an endless journey for his wife who left him.

results.title: A Friend, No Longer Here
results.overview: Ahmed moved back to Egypt from Saudi Arabia in 2017. That was the last time he saw his classmate and best friend. This evocative account of loss uses videos and an inner monologue to look back in time and, through six symbolic gifts, explores why some friendships fall apart and where the line between care and dependence lies.

results.title: F*CK HALLOWEEN
results.overview: Two friends go trick-or-treating with one goal: steal as much candy as possible. Unfortunately, they choose the wrong house to f*ck with.

results.title: Repo! This Movie: The Anatomy of a Cult
results.original_title: Repo! This Movie: The Anatomy of a Cult
results.overview: Featuring insights from director Darren Lynn Bousman and cast members, a look at how the dark, cybergoth rock opera Repo! The Genetic Opera – originating from a modest theatrical stage play – blended industrial goth aesthetics, high-camp operatic numbers, and comic-book gore into an enduring midnight-movie cult classic. The feature-length documentary highlights the grassroots fan movement, shadowcasts, and interactive community gatherings, ala The Rocky Horror Picture Show.

results.title: Until the End
results.overview: As the world falls apart, a woman's ex-husband asks her for one last, huge favor: to end his life before he changes.

results.title: Merge
results.overview: Merge follows Ari, a young woman in her 20's who decides to step outside of her comfort zone through an acting class. While there, she meets an interesting group of students led by their enigmatic teacher, Joy, who challenges Ari to harness her deepest fears in order to peak vulnerability in performance.  Through an exercise with a self-assured partner named Nicholas, Ari is forced to lean into the unconventional teaching methods of the class, and her initial disbelief in the process transforms into a love for power and honesty.

results.title: Everything I Saw Was Meant for You
results.original_title: Everything I Saw Was Meant for You
results.overview: “Everything I Saw Was Meant for You” is a film seen through the screens of others. Recorded in public spaces, it follows the circulation of sounds and images carried by devices that increasingly frame everyday life.  The film takes the logic of the endless feed as its editing structure: an open-ended cinema that reshapes itself, where sonic fragments appear, disappear and reconnect as attention drifts. Each screen leads into another stream that pays out in seconds, then spins again.

results.title: Camp Night
results.overview: Five friends from Chicago head into the woods for a weekend getaway with their coworkers. What begins as a chance to escape the everyday quickly turns terrifying when the group discovers that the legend surrounding their destination is far from a campfire story.

results.title: Dwijihwa
results.overview: Kumaresh, on the run from a repressive right wing party, must spend the night at the home of a comrade who undergoes a strange shift over the course of the night, which progresses in anxiety and outright terror.

results.title: Snow at Zabala Park
results.overview: On his birthday, Luciano waits for Agustín in Plaza Zabala. He sends him voice messages downplaying the hours going by, but the wait begins to weigh on him more than he lets on.

results.title: John Simpson - 60 Years at the BBC
results.original_title: John Simpson - 60 Years at the BBC
results.overview: John Simpson looks back at his extraordinary 60-year career at the BBC - reporting on the biggest global stories of the era. In a frank, personal and revealing documentary, he reflects on the changing world he has witnessed: the revolution in Iran that seemed destined to fail, his brutal kidnapping in Beirut, the fall of the Berlin Wall, two wars in Iraq, the invasion of Afghanistan and a mind-altering trip up the Amazon.
